summary.text: Tim Moffitt is a Republican member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 48 since January 2023 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
He owns a management consulting firm and previously served in the North Carolina House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Tim Moffitt's professional experience includes owning a management consulting firm called Moffitt International, according to Ballotpedia.
Moffitt served in the North Carolina House of Representatives for District 116 from 2011 to 2015 and for District 117 from 2020 to 2023.
He assumed office in the State Senate on January 1, 2023, succeeding Chuck Edwards.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as Appropriations on Agriculture, Natural and Economic Resources, Commerce and Insurance, Finance, Health Care, and Transportation.
